environment.description: Same service deployed in a hardened Kubernetes pod with a custom seccomp profile (seccomp-bpf-restrict-nullptr.json) that intercepts SIGSEGV/SIGBUS via a custom signal handler registered at container init, combined with dropped capabilities (NET_RAW, SYS_ADMIN removed from both allowed and effective sets). The pod spec includes a securityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation:false and runAsNonRoot:true. An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate enforces that all containers in the namespace must declare readOnlyRootFilesystem:true and drop ALL capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE. The container image is built with panic=unwind and a custom panic hook that gracefully returns HTTP 500 instead of process termination, compiled with RUSTFLAGS='-C panic=unwind' and a registered std::panic::set_hook that catches the unwind.

config.custom_panic_hook: std::panic::set_hook converting panics to HTTP 500 responses via catch_unwind in handler wrapper
config.network_policy: deny-all ingress except from ingress-controller namespace
